maria_cs: Heads-up — Helio (onboarding) is hitting intermittent 401 then 429 during SDK init from their Android WebView app after they flipped on an Okta proxy. They say it started after we changed token TTL for ephemeral keys. Can eng/devex help triage?
helio_dev: repro steps: app initializes -> hits /v1/init -> sometimes 401, next retry gets 429. Happening on devices behind our corp SSO. Sample log: `[{\"ts\":\"2026-03-20T15:12:03Z\",\"code\":401,\"msg\":\"invalid_token\"},{\"ts\":\"2026-03-20T15:12:04Z\",\"code\":429,\"msg\":\"rate_limited\"}]`
eli_engineer: thanks — can you paste the request headers (redact tokens)? especially Authorization & any x-forwarded headers. suspect proxy might be duplicating headers or re-signing.
helio_dev: here's sanitized snippet (we redacted token payload):
```
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
User-Agent: HelioApp/1.2.3 (Android WebView)
X-Forwarded-For: 10.2.3.4
X-Okta-Proxy: enabled
```
sam_devex: whoa two Authorization lines. Redwood server picks the first, but Okta re-inserts one during proxy -> token mismatch/jwt validation sometimes fails and our client retries, then fanout causes RPS spike -> 429.
julie_support: customer saw this only after TTL tweak? could be timing + proxy rewriting. Also their client does immediate retry on 401 with no jitter which aggravates.
maria_cs: action items: 1) eng check server behavior for duplicated Authorization 2) devex give a suggested retry/backoff and header check snippet 3) ask Helio to test Okta passthrough off for a quick repro window.
eli_engineer: quick patch idea: tolerate duplicate Authorization by preferring the last non-empty header if the first fails validation — low risk and helps proxied setups. I'll run a small experiment on staging.
sam_devex: in meantime advise Helio to add small client-side backoff + single-header enforcement. Example (JS/Android):
```
// ensure single auth header
if (headers.getAll("Authorization").length > 1) {
  headers.set("Authorization", headers.getAll("Authorization").pop());
}
// exponential backoff on 401 before immediate retry
```
helio_dev: can try toggling Okta passthrough now for 10m window. We'll also push a small WebView header sanitization patch.
ops-bot: incident created: CS-1909-okta-auth-dup (priority: low) — assigned to eli_engineer.
eli_engineer: staging experiment results: server currently uses the first Authorization header. If first fails, it does not re-check later headers -> client gets 401 even though later header is valid. Patch looks straightforward: iterate headers and try validation until one works. I've opened PR r/infra/392.
maria_cs: awesome, thanks. helio, want to join a quick 20m call after you test passthrough so we can watch logs together? :calendar:
helio_dev: yes, testing now. will report in 8-10m.
julie_support: noted renewal risk: this blocks a key feature demo; tagging AM for visibility.
maria_cs: tracked. will update after helio confirms. :thumbsup:
